title: IUU+DB: Tracking Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated Fishing, Seafood Fraud, and Labor Abuse through LLM-driven Information Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2606.18181v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing (IUU) traditionally refers to fishing activities that violate applicable laws or occur in areas that lack applicable laws. We propose the term IUU+ to capture a broader suite of fisheries sector environmental and associated supply chain trade-related crimes and behaviors. Although IUU+ activity is widely recognized as a serious threat to marine ecosystems, markets, and livelihoods, a quantitative understanding of these incidents, e.g., their frequency, geography, species, actors, and patterns in the type of illicit activity, remains difficult to obtain. We propose IUU+DB, a large language model driven system for building a global incident database of IUU+ activity. translated_title: IUU+DB：通过大语言模型驱动的信息抽取追踪非法、未报告和无管制捕捞、海鲜欺诈及劳工虐待
translated_abstract: 非法、未报告和无管制捕捞（IUU）传统上指违反适用法律或发生在缺乏适用法律区域的捕捞活动。我们提出"IUU+"这一术语，以涵盖更广泛的渔业部门环境犯罪及相关供应链贸易犯罪和行为。尽管IUU+活动被广泛认为对海洋生态系统、市场和生计构成严重威胁，但对这些事件的量化理解——例如其发生频率、地理分布、涉及的物种、行为主体以及非法活动类型的模式——仍然难以获得。我们提出IUU+DB，一个由大语言模型驱动的系统，用于构建IUU+活动的全球事件数据库。该系统可摄取异构文档，判断其是否描述相关事件，并提取行为主体、地点、物种、船只、违规行为和执法结果等关键数据元素，同时支持……
tldr: 本文提出IUU+DB系统，利用大语言模型驱动的信息抽取技术，从异构文档中自动分类和提取渔业犯罪事件的关键数据，构建首个覆盖IUU捕捞、海鲜欺诈及劳工虐待的全球事件数据库。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes IUU+DB, an LLM-driven information extraction system that builds a global incident database of IUU fishing, seafood fraud, and labor abuse by automatically classifying heterogeneous documents and extracting key data elements such as actors, locations, species, vessels, and violations.
